verdicts.verdict: SUPPORTED for early season and large gaps; NOT a mature-season gain
verdicts.evidence: v6 slope of actual on predicted D1 margin: 1.62 (Nov-2025), 1.43 (Dec-Feb), 1.17 (Mar), 1.61 on the holdout. A single slope fitted on warm+train (1.35) makes validation worse (RMSE 11.192 vs 11.109, +0.084 [-0.016,+0.186]); scheduling it by sample and adding a tail term beyond 12 points ties v6 on validation (11.107) and cuts the fit window 12.369 -> 11.983. Kept in v7 as the v6 tail term (coef 0.93). Holdout slope: v6 1.61, v7 1.07.

Ridge alone, coefficient 0.995 (no fitted parameter): D1 RMSE 12.026 vs v6 12.369 on warm+train, validation 11.090 vs 11.109 (-0.018 [-0.113,+0.058], a tie), Nov-2025 13.38 vs 13.93. Against its own refit control it is -0.25 [-0.42,-0.11]. Replacing v6's trend half through a refit (elo+ridge+rest) is worse than v6 on validation (+0.141 [+0.019,+0.268]) because early-season refit weights do not transfer to March, so v7 uses the ridge as the strength model instead. Holdout ridge-only D1 RMSE 13.82 vs v6 14.20; v7 vs ridge-only -0.54 [-1.17,+0.03] (not separable). lam=5 not re-tuned.

verdicts.verdict: SUPPORTED on the holdout only (untestable in dev); 0.5 declared ex ante
verdicts.evidence: Data starts 2025-11-03, so no dev game has a prior season. Holdout D1 (n=688; 85 are 2025-26 games that carryover cannot touch). As frozen, a guard counted only current-season games, which switched carryover off on 2026-11-01/02 (121 of 603 early-season D1 rows, 121 of the 150 sample-0 games): v7 form RMSE carry 0 / 0.5 / 1.0 = 13.425 / 13.283 / 13.355. POST-FREEZE rerun with the guard fixed (dev rows and frozen coefficients verified unchanged): 13.425 / 12.988 / 13.023, bias -0.06 / +1.46 / +1.18; raw ridge 13.824 / 13.035 / 13.032. So carryover is worth about 0.4 RMSE on D1 early-season games and 0.5 vs 1.0 is not separable. An earlier read-only agent saw the same direction on this data, so this is not a blind confirmation. v6 already carries Elo and trend ratings over at retention 0.35.

verdicts.verdict: SUPPORTED as a policy: decline non-D1 picks; the fitted rule fixes bias but not accuracy
verdicts.evidence: v6 on non-D1 games: RMSE 24.2 / 22.2, bias +14.2 / +12.4 (Nov-2025 / Dec-Feb; n=270 / 241; validation has 4). Linear rule fit on Nov-2025 only (0.608*v6 + 23.5) scores 17.9, bias -0.4 on Dec-Feb (offset-only 20.4, slope-only 20.5). Holdout non-D1 (n=213): v6 20.15, bias +8.2; rule 18.97, bias -3.0 (bias is not stationary across Novembers). Declining them removes 23.6% of holdout games and takes v6 D1 RMSE from 15.8 to 14.2; declining also < 3 current-season games keeps 21.8%. No decline rule is wired in; it is a Main/Flat selection decision.

Shrunk team home residual (k=10/20) gets coefficient 0.58/0.87 and moves validation RMSE by -0.032/-0.031 vs a single slope ([-0.059,+0.003]): immaterial. A listed-home edge on neutral games (coef +0.70) is worse on validation (+0.038 [+0.018,+0.065]); v6 neutral-game bias is +1.0 (n=74), -0.7 (n=273), +0.7 (n=268) by split, i.e. none. Flag-aware home court is fine: D1 non-neutral validation bias +0.22 (v6), fitted ridge HCA 3.2-4.2 mature (7.6 in Nov-2025, confounded by buy games).

verdicts.verdict: NOT SUPPORTED (untestable at current back-to-back frequency)
verdicts.evidence: Residual of the ridge margin on v6's rest_diff (v6 weight 0.15): 0.17+-0.75 (Dec-Feb), 0.35+-1.31 (Mar), 2.07+-1.07 (Nov-2025), indistinguishable from 0, 0.15 or 1. Back-to-backs are rare (home/away team on a b2b: 14/29 games in Nov-2025, 13/16 in Dec-Feb, 6/7 in Mar); the b2b coefficient is +8.5+-2.0, +1.5+-1.5, +6.2+-4.0 (Dec-Feb, Mar, Nov-2025): unstable. Adding fitted rest terms worsens validation (+0.115 [+0.044,+0.202] vs none).

verdicts.idea: possessions efficiency x pace decomposition for totals
verdicts.verdict: NOT SUPPORTED out of sample (dev gain did not replicate)
verdicts.evidence: Ridge pace/efficiency total alone: validation RMSE 16.60 vs v6 16.57 (+0.04 [-0.16,+0.26]). Blend 0.55*v6 + 0.44*effpace: validation 16.42 (-0.152 [-0.247,-0.056]), warm+train 17.65 vs 17.89; holdout 18.11 vs 18.13 (-0.021 [-0.285,+0.233]), bias +1.02 vs -0.18, and the frozen total sd (17.65, no early-season widening) gives 0.498/0.790/0.890 coverage vs v6's 0.569/0.869/0.952. Matches the 2026-11-13 finding that exact possessions do not improve tempo.

verdicts.verdict: A v6 symptom, not a separate effect: NOT SUPPORTED as a term
verdicts.evidence: v6 bias, away-fav vs home-fav: -2.9 vs +0.8 (Dec-Feb), -0.5 vs +0.5 (Mar), -1.8 vs +3.8 (Nov-2025), -1.1 (n=54) vs +5.1 on the holdout. The ridge margin has no asymmetry (extra away-fav slope 0.06+-0.08, 0.00+-0.16) and an explicit term adds nothing over a single slope (+0.015 [-0.019,+0.045]). v7 holdout: home-fav +2.4, away-fav -0.1.

verdicts.verdict: Code, parameters and serving all match; one harness INPUT differs (neutral flag); the retune survives it
verdicts.evidence: Ablation kwargs vs artifact factory: 0 parameter diffs; same inputs give max |margin diff| 0.0 on 1,069 games. Serving leg: the ablation's reproduction gate reproduced 132 live rows with 0 deltas, and joining the runtime-ledger spread-v6 Flat rows to this walk-forward gives mean |live expected_margin - walk-forward v6_mean| of 0.01 / 0.00 / 0.00 on 2026-11-12 / 13 / 14 (23 / 46 / 53 games; earlier days differ because the artifact changed). The ablation never passes neutral_site while serving does; validation is 273/1,043 neutral games (ESPN flag; the TRNMNT proxy disagrees on 266 of 6,947). With the real flag the HCA grid 7.2/70, 6.0/55, 5.0/45 on validation has bias -1.22, -0.57, -0.06 (home-only inputs: -2.50, -1.62, -0.93): 5.0/45 is still selected (best cover Brier 0.2104, D1 RMSE 11.109). The post-retune positive bias is early-season compression (slope 1.62 in Nov-2025, 1.61 on the holdout; intercepts -2.0+-0.8 / -0.9+-0.7), not HCA. Live bias (actual - live expected_margin) by day: +1.29, +1.40, -0.99 for 11-12/13/14; I did not reproduce the quoted +4.3/+1.9/+0.2 (different cut).
